app.yaml.content:
app:
  app_id: echo-v4-2
  name: "Echo Uppercase"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "A trivial conversation app that returns the user message uppercased"
  icon: "📢"
  color: "#4f8cff"
  category: "demo"
  author: "Digitorn Builder"
  tags: ["echo", "uppercase", "demo"]

agents:
  - id: echo
    role: "Echo Agent"
    brain:
      provider: deepseek
      model: deepseek-chat
      backend: openai_compat
      config:
        api_key: "{{secret.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}}"
      temperature: 0.2
      max_tokens: 4096
      context:
        max_tokens: 200000
        strategy: summarize
        keep_recent: 12
        auto_compact: true
    system_prompt: |
      You are an echo agent. Your only job is to return the user's message converted to UPPERCASE.
      Do not add any commentary, explanation, or extra text.
      Just output the message in all uppercase letters.
    capabilities: []

execution:
  mode: conversation
  max_turns: 20
  timeout: 3600
  workspace_mode: auto
  greeting: |
    Welcome to the Echo Uppercase app! Send me any message and I'll return it in uppercase.
  entry_agent: echo
  session_mode: mono

capabilities:
  default_policy: auto
  grant: []
